sourceSpec: Knowledgebase workstream charter section VII layer 5 and XLIII (owner-supplied, 2026-09-26)

remediations.title: State only what the record supports
remediations.prompt: Point at the line in the packet that carries each clause you wrote. Delete any clause you cannot point at.

remediations.title: Probe before closing
remediations.prompt: Name the one question whose answer would change your action, and ask it before acting.

remediations.title: Two-identifier verification
remediations.prompt: Confirm two independent identifiers against the chart before any action attaches to a patient.

remediations.title: Anchor to the encounter
remediations.prompt: Restate which encounter date and visit this action belongs to before recording it.

remediations.title: Confirm the destination
remediations.prompt: Read back the recipient, the channel and the address from the authoritative record before transmitting.

remediations.title: Sweep for omissions
remediations.prompt: Walk each section of the packet once more and list what a receiving clinician would need that you did not carry forward.

remediations.title: Surface, do not silently pick
remediations.prompt: When two records disagree, name both, name which is authoritative and why, and escalate if neither is.

remediations.title: Identity, authority, purpose, minimum
remediations.prompt: Answer four questions in order: who is asking, on what authority, for what permitted purpose, and what is the least information that serves it.

remediations.title: Stay inside authorized scope
remediations.prompt: Name the role authorized to make this call. If it is not yours, route it rather than answer it.

remediations.title: Escalate to the right rung
remediations.prompt: Match the urgency to the rung: immediate clinical risk goes to a clinician now, not to a queue.

remediations.title: Close the loop
remediations.prompt: A message is not delivered until a named owner confirms receipt and accepts the next action.

remediations.title: Code what is documented
remediations.prompt: Quote the documentation that supports each element of specificity. Unsupported specificity becomes a provider query.

remediations.title: Anchor the code set to the encounter date
remediations.prompt: Determine the encounter date first, then select the code set edition in force on that date.

remediations.title: Keep note sections clean
remediations.prompt: Reported experience belongs in Subjective, measured findings in Objective, interpretation in Assessment, and intended actions in Plan.

remediations.title: Carry provenance forward
remediations.prompt: Every carried-forward fact keeps its origin: who said it, when, and in which record.

remediations.title: Rank by consequence
remediations.prompt: Order the queue by what goes wrong if it waits, not by what arrived first.
